validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye from 220-dpi crops of the table half of each spread (24 table pages, 2 per crop); tesseract not needed. Numerical index (printed pp52-55) read by eye in full, column by column at full resolution, typed out and compared with the transcription in both directions on (part, page, ref); every difference re-checked on zoomed crops of both the index and the table. Compared row by row with the 8-3140 file after the transcription was complete.
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except: hood ref 23, electrical system ref 14 and electrical hardware ref 13 are not printed (index agrees). The carburetor REF column is in register in this book (stored as printed; the carburetor row itself is unnumbered). Repeated refs kept as printed (pistons 12 x4, ring sets 13 x4, valve covers 22 x2, push rods 26 x2, fuel tank brackets 10 x2, choke/throttle control 1 x2, foot rests 16 x2, hood bolt 20 x2, pads 27 x2, transaxle washers 26 x3, electrical hardware 10 x2 and 16 x2, hood decals 1 x2). 8 unnumbered rows kept (carburetor, carburetor gasket kit, carburetor overhaul kit, starter, hydrostatic transmission, seal kit, input assembly, headlight assembly).
validation.quantities: Every row has a qty; 14 rows are UAR. No REQ'D column is out of register. Engine block ref 22 C34369 (R.H. valve cover) prints qty 2 (kept, flagged).
validation.numericalIndex: 633 index entries (printed pp52-55) against 635 indexable rows (NSS rows and the paint and oil page are not indexed). 628 agree exactly (627 as printed plus 7/23 after the correction below). 5 rows where the index gives a different part number for the same position (hood 25/1 C29214, belts 37/27 114- 214, electrical hardware 47/3 182- 559, 47/5 C34117 and 47/18 132- 344): table kept, each flagged. 2 table rows are not indexed (air cleaner 13/16 C29855 and 13/17 C37544). Engine block 7/23 prints C 34262 (duplicate of ref 24); the index lists C34367, stored as C34367 (8-3140 precedent). Gasket sets 17/18 prints C34279 in both table and index (stored as printed; 8-3140 uses C34379). C33726 is not indexed because this book has no transaxle assembly row.
validation.partNoForms: Ingersoll C numbers closed up (C34371); Briggs BR numbers stored bare (221798, 221535); hardware codes "NNN-NNNN" (113-103, 138-2071, 321-6659, 353-454); 49 NSS rows stored as NSS with source null. Printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted.
validation.siblingCheck: Row-by-row against 8-3140 (same ref and part number): engine sections identical (flywheel 23/23, ignition 12/12, engine block 39/39, crankcase 24/24, blower 12/12), carburetor same parts with refs one lower, gasket sets 18/19, hydrostatic 29/30, transaxle 62/63, freewheel 10/10, weight box 7/7; chassis sections differ (lift system 0/41, electrical 4/18, fuel system 5/9, front axle 8/23, travel control 9/17, oil filter 10/16, hood 22/33, seat/fenders 10/17).
decisions: 2026-11-17 (user): table value kept on every index-vs-table difference (25/1, 37/27, 47/3, 47/5, 47/18), on gasket sets 17/18 (C34279) and on the two rows not in the index (13/16, 13/17); engine block 7/23 stored as C34367 (index value)
